question_text: For each gate, how many people came in versus how many went out during the day? I want to see if the numbers balance.

gold.sql: SELECT camera_location, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('person_entry','car_entry') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS entries, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('person_exit','car_exit') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exits FROM events WHERE event_type IN ('person_entry','person_exit','car_entry','car_exit') AND timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z' GROUP BY camera_location ORDER BY camera_location

metadata.tests: entry/exit balance per gate — graph traverses Event→Camera→Location with event_type filtering
